test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

 Statements:

 All boys are handsome.

 Some handsome are cars.

 Some cars are grey.

 Conclusions:

 (I) All handsome are boys.

 (II) All cars are handsome.
solution:
** Statements:**

 All boys are handsome.

 Some handsome are cars.

 Some cars are grey.

The least possible Venn Diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/334a522b5af2736a0f15040b74ae09d2b75db9c3077918b1bbdfb9ac4a25386c.png] 

** Conclusions:**

 (I) All handsome are boys - **False**(because all boys are handsome is given. it implies that some handsome are boys not all).

 (II) All cars are handsome - **False**(some handsome are cars, so it can be possible only).

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
